status: Proposed; implementation and acceptance checks not started
approach: Six working increments over one modular control plane and an isolated application-owned evaluation worker.

phases.title: 1. Foundation and durable storage
phases.detail: Management API, SQLite/PostgreSQL storage contracts, scoped access, audit, assets and outbox. Gate: restart preserves state; stale edits and unauthorized access are rejected.

phases.title: 2. Manifests, variant drafts and build-pinned workers
phases.detail: Build export/registration, contract diffs, typed no-call preflight, standalone journal binding and strict candidate mode. Gate: wrong build or fallback cannot cause a paid call.
phases.risk: Runtime API, serializer authority and production isolation

phases.title: 3. Replay-ready datasets and frozen benchmarks
phases.detail: Typed inputs/assets, references, splits/exposure, criterion bindings and primary/guardrail policies. Gate: frozen data is immutable and missing evidence is explicit.
phases.risk: Input authority, reference policy and acceptance leakage

phases.title: 4. Durable backtest and reassessment jobs
phases.detail: Claim-bound journals, progress, cancel/resume, late-receipt reconciliation, workload origin and spend coverage. Gate: uncertain sends are held; offline work never enters production metrics.
phases.risk: Paid dispatch, crash recovery and duplicate accounting

phases.title: 5. Scoped judges, review and exact comparisons
phases.detail: Human/deterministic/LLM assessments, calibration, source evidence, owned review and variant/version matrices. Gate: discoveries require adjudication; revised references reassess all compared outputs fairly.
phases.risk: Judge evidence, calibration and historical result integrity

phases.title: 6. Publish, observe and capture regressions
phases.detail: Qualified publication CAS/history, explicit promotion, host adoption, execution/assignment/timing evidence and trace-to-case workflow. Gate: conflicts/restarts reconcile without overwrites or invented adoption.
phases.risk: Target activation, runtime evidence and fleet state

architecture: One modular .NET API with in-process job/outbox service initially; compact Vue/Nuxt UI.
SQLite for one local instance; PostgreSQL for qualified shared deployment. Selected at bootstrap.
Separate app-owned worker/runtime pinned to a build; host-approved clients, policies and typed dispatch.
Independent read/publish ports; PostgreSQL first for qualified CAS/history. File remains development/current-only.
Separate asset port, persistent filesystem first; optional retained-trace adapter/deep links.
runtimeAdditions: Optional standalone invocation/worker journal binding; the current journal parameter is internal.
Strict candidate preparation for evaluation: fail before send when the requested configuration cannot run.
Authoritative workload origin plus intended-assignment, elapsed and execution/attempt correlation evidence.
acceptance: A stale worker cannot start a call; a valid late completion is retained.
Start without reliable completion is held, never automatically resent.
Wrong build, signature, override or render fails before provider dispatch in strict mode.
Backtest and evaluator traffic cannot enter production metrics.
Exact original outputs and frozen reports survive reference, rubric and configuration changes.
Publication conflicts and lost acknowledgements reconcile without blind overwrite.
later: CI gates, scheduling, alerts, automatic promotion, additional runtime/asset adapters and statistical winner claims follow the same immutable protocol.
scope: Includes scoped LLM judging. No application implementation, provider calls, containers, secrets or migrations are performed by this proposal.
